question: Which syllables are invoked to protect the left side and the spine?
premises: The syllable hūṃ is invoked to protect the left side
The letter sa is invoked to protect the spine
inference: Protective syllables are assigned to the left side of the body and the spinal column.
plain_english: May the syllable hūṃ protect the left side, and may the letter sa indeed protect the spine.
